description: Terraform provider for managing 3x-ui panel inbounds, clients, settings, and Xray configuration via its HTTP API.
rules: This repository is a Terraform Provider (type name `threexui`), NOT the 3x-ui panel. Users manage resources/data sources such as threexui_inbound, threexui_inbound_client, threexui_panel_*, and threexui_xray_*.
Resources/data sources are built with terraform-plugin-framework (not SDKv2). Schema helpers live in provider/<area>_schema.go.

Inbound settings, stream_settings, and sniffing use typed Terraform blocks/attributes, not raw JSON strings in HCL. Conversion has three layers: typed Terraform models <-> map[string]any (expand/flatten) <-> panel API JSON strings (build). See provider/settings.go and provider/stream_settings.go.
The 3x-ui-<version>/ directories are read-only upstream source snapshots used only to verify API/struct truth for drift tests. Never cite their code as the provider's own API.

Use compat-versions.json for supported/default 3x-ui versions and terraform-versions.json for Terraform CLI support. Feature minimums and unmodeled configurations are documented in docs/guides/version-compatibility.md; acceptance tests use requireMinVersion/requireBelowVersion.

Provider authentication happens before resource updates. Keep desired provider and threexui_panel_user credentials aligned; before each rotation, set bootstrap_username/bootstrap_password to the currently active credentials. Fresh 3x-ui v3.11.0+ panels generate random first-user credentials, not admin/admin.

Provider configurations and alias selection must be static; Terraform cannot generate providers with for_each. Child modules must declare source batonogov/threexui. See examples/multi-server for static aliases.

Shared-document mutexes protect only one provider process. Separate provider processes or Terraform runs do not share locks; do not concurrently manage the same panel through separate aliases or runs.
